name: Mist corridor east
purpose: From the warm Mirror toward the 6 °C glacier: the corridor water stops steaming and turns glass-clear, the warm niches give out, and the first icicles hang from the ceiling ahead in blue light; a shoji door on the right leads to the treatment rooms.

ceiling_profile.note: Basalt barrel 3 m; the last 6 m are rimed with frost and hung with icicles (to -18.3).

spurs.note: p_b1_east_treat is in the 3.7 m of rock between this corridor (south wall y≈83.7) and the treatment hall (y 80): a short threshold tunnel.

hero.why: In 35 m you go from 35 °C to 6 °C. The blue-lit ice hanging at the far end is the only cold light on B1's warm circuit; it is what you walk toward from the Mirror's east arch, and it hangs above the glacier door like a curtain.

anchored.why: Treatment rooms entrance: a quiet timber doorway with an indigo noren in the south wall.
Temperature board at the glacier door, lit by the ice light.
Silhouette on the north kerb just outside the Mirror's arch.

water.note: Same -20.05 surface; no steam after x 155 (the water is visibly clearer and cooler toward the glacier).

sightlines.see: Down the corridor: warm niche pools, the treatment door glow on the right, blue ice light at the far end.
Looking back west: warm niches leading to the Mirror arch's teal leak.
Stepping out of the treatment rooms: blue ice to the right, the Mirror's teal to the left.

concept.match: Corridor mood with a cold end: stepping stones in clear water, warm niches doubled, the treatment door's glow on the right, blue icicles and cold light where the corridor ends.

lights.why: Warm niches stagger to x 156.5 then stop: the last 8 m are lit only by the blue ice (cold gap, hero brightest).
Blue light inside the ice, spilling from the glacier.

dressing.why: The walk itself: two staggered rows of polished pads (tops at -20.00, water 5 cm lower) make a 1.5 m path; this is the nav line.
Low wet rocks where the pool meets the kerb: detail at the edges, middle kept open.
Frost and small ice on the walls in the last 6 m, building toward the door.

mood.key: blue ice at the end of a warm corridor
mood.palette: amber niches fading to cold blue; clear teal water
mood.mist: Warm knee-high mist near the Mirror thinning to a flat cold ground fog at the glacier end.

conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
